events.content: Hi! I can help you find a movie to watch. What kind of movie are you in the mood for?

Great — want a single pick, please. Quick defaults so we're on the same page:

- genres contains Animation
- content_rating == PG

I'm watching with kids and I prefer funny over serious. I have Netflix, Paramount+, HBO Max, and Disney+.

Surprise me — pick one movie (no lists) and commit to it.
